name: deconvreg
setup: I = checkerboard(8); PSF = fspecial('gaussian', 7, 10); B = imfilter(I, PSF, 'circular'); regop2 = [1 -1 0; -1 0 1; 0 1 -1];
comment: Sig: [J,LAGRA] = deconvreg(I, PSF, NP, LRANGE, REGOP). Branches: 2-arg default, 3-arg NP, 4-arg scalar LRANGE (fixed λ), 4-arg [lo,hi] (Brent fminbnd search), 5-arg custom 2-D REGOP. fminbnd uses Brent's golden-section + parabolic-interpolation (Brent 1973). Algorithm: Gonzalez-Woods + Jain. Image namespace 2026-05-27.
